name: b2b-deal-execution
description: Win the B2B deal in front of you: review deal health from your own deal facts with every point shown as an example default you can change, build a mutual close plan with the buyer on a working day calendar and a 30, 60 and 90 day account plan, write discovery questions in your framework (MEDDPICC, BANT, SPICED, Challenger, Gap Selling) and map the buying group, hold the price in a negotiation and give your champion an internal selling asset in their own voice, and write deal stage email sequences.
